# DiggerTerm v0.0.2

### 简体中文

- 新增 SSH 交互会话、Windows / WSL 外部终端与 Agent 进程**只读观察**，以及紧凑可调整的多终端工作区。
- 新增配色、界面/终端字号、语言、默认 Shell 与启动目录等设置；修复 Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V，兼容 nano 等全屏终端程序的原生按键。

**下载：** Windows `.exe`、Linux `.AppImage`、Ubuntu/Debian `.deb`（x64）。SHA-256 校验值随 [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.2/SHA256SUMS) 一并提供。

> Windows 包未签名。Linux 包主要在 Ubuntu 24.04 上验证，旧版发行版兼容性不保证。

### English

- Added interactive SSH sessions, **read-only** Windows / WSL terminal and agent process discovery, and a compact, resizable terminal workspace.
- Added themes, UI/terminal font sizing, language and default shell/startup-directory settings; fixed Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V and preserved native nano-style shortcuts.

**Downloads:** Windows `.exe`, Linux `.AppImage`, and Ubuntu/Debian `.deb` (x64). SHA-256 hashes are included in [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.2/SHA256SUMS).

> The Windows build is unsigned. Linux builds were primarily tested on Ubuntu 24.04; older distributions may be incompatible.
